analysis: Spot buyers are actively absorbing heavy perpetual short flows, pushing price marginally above the Value Area High at $82,700. A sustained hold above VAH could trigger a forced squeeze on derivative shorts, whereas a failure to hold risks a sharp mean-reversion toward POC at $82,600.
key_risk: Acceptance failure back inside the Value Area below $82,700, risking a liquidation-driven rotation down to POC.
